//: Issue #840. This file exists for ONE reason: @typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises
needs type information, and type information needs a real TS project.
It is NOT here because the compiler finds unawaited promises. It does not.
Verified: `tsc --noEmit --strict` on a file containing both a floating async
call and a genuine type error reports ONLY the type error. Floating promises are
invisible to tsc at every strictness level. The lint rule is the thing that
catches them; this config is just the fuel it runs on.
Scope is deliberately tests/**/*.ts only. jsconfig.json still governs the .js
source tree; widening type-aware linting to src/ is a separate, much larger job.
The 149-vs-66 unawaited WB.scan() split that motivated #840 was entirely in tests.
strict is OFF on purpose. Turning it on would bury the floating-promise signal
under thousands of unrelated null/implicit-any errors on 546 never-checked test
files. no-floating-promises does not need strict. Tighten later, from a green base.
